question: How is the Lord described in his inner fullness and outward beauty?
premises: The Lord possesses the middle power filled with all inner beings.
From the nature of his own willed agitation arises the bliss of the world.
That arising bliss makes him beautiful.
inference: The Lord's inner fullness and self-willed agitation manifest as the blissful beauty of the world.
plain_english: He has the middle power filled with all beings within, and he is beautiful with the bliss of the world rising from the nature of his own willed agitation.
